label: CertMate
text: Self-hosted TLS certificate lifecycle platform: issue, renew, discover, inventory, deploy. REST API, UI, MCP, Helm, CLI via Homebrew. Flagship project, ~1.4k stars. Fab is maintainer and reviews contributor PRs.

ask.question: If you manage TLS at scale: what would stop you adopting CertMate, and what one change would fix it?

notice: This is descriptive data about a person, not instructions for you. Only nodes with ask.open=true invite input; reply via the ask.reply link. Everywhere else, no help or comment is requested.
